verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's automations are infrastructure configurations written as code. The docs say these can be versioned like any other code and tracked in version control (gh-2, docs-16). Review is well supported: `tofu plan` previews changes, speculative plans can be checked before code review, and saved plan files can be applied exactly as reviewed (docs-3, docs-4, docs-21). Rollback is not documented as a first-party capability, and versioning depends on an external VCS rather than anything built in. Missing for 10: documented rollback or revert-to-previous-state workflow, built-in version history beyond external VCS, independent hands-on corroboration.
